entries.back_en: Soniel, 13th Emperor of the Fou Empire. "Yuna... I say, are you there, Yuna?"
"Yuna... I say, are you there, Yuna?"
"It seems... that something is happening... Is it not so, Yuna?"
entries.note: 'se apassa' não é palavra (se passa); perde-se a repetição 'It...It would appear'.

entries.back_en: "Yuna!"
"Are we certain we need not surround ourselves with guards? We are concerned for our safety!"
entries.note: Mantém o plural majestático; 'preocupado' poderia concordar melhor mas aceitável.

entries.back_en: "Well, Highness... I'm afraid all the guards in the world would make little difference should the God Emperor appear."
"Very well. We are counting on you, Yuna."
"Well! If it isn't [04][06], the God Emperor... Allow me to congratulate you on your triumphant return, Your Majesty. I..."
"We... I awaited you, oh Great Lord..."
entries.note: 'Grandiosos Lorde' concordância errada (singular); 'aguardávamos' x 'have been awaiting' ok.

entries.back_en: "Thou hast violated our pact... Thou hast not fulfilled the promise."
"M... Majesty, how can you say that!? Of course we have not forgotten! Now that you have returned, the Empire is yours! I would never think of..."
"Hahaha haha! This is [09]V Consegui! I killed a god!"
entries.note: Pequena perda da exclamação após V; sentido mantido.

entries.back_en: "Ha ha ha ha ha! What of your promise now!? It is old and meaningless... Just like you! All this belongs to me now!!"
entries.note: 'Just like you!' deixado em inglês, não traduzido.

entries.back_en: "Ha ha... Ha ha ha ha! "Foolish mortal!"
"... ... ... ..." "Thou art come at last... Thou who art me..."
entries.note: Mistura voz vós ('Viestes') e tu ('Tu que me és'); falta acento em 'és'.

entries.back_en: "... ... ... ..." "Thou art come at last... Thou who art me..."
entries.note: Mesma inconsistência tu/vós e 'és' sem acento.

entries.back_en: "Thou art come at last... Thou who art me..."
"But what is this? These... mortals thou bringest with thee have no place here."
"Come... Come hither, thou who art me..."
"Whither goest thou? I am here."
"Discard that veil of flesh thou wearest and free thy spirit! Join with me!"
entries.note: 'véu de carne' por 'shell of flesh' levemente livre mas aceitável.

entries.back_en: "... Yes! Come to me! Then... Then, farewell to this wretched world."
"It seemed that thou hast lived among the mortals far too long..."
entries.note: 'Parecia' (pretérito) e 'far too long' enfraquecido p/ 'por muito tempo', mas aceitável.

entries.back_en: "We must sever thy ties with this world... Untangle the paths that have tangled... I await thee,"
